vehicles.lede: Every vehicle Rockstar has named so far, with where it comes from. The full list, with stats and where to find each one, starts on November 19.

items.d: Grotti's mid-'90s sports car with a minimalist, retro-futuristic livery. Unlocks for later-stage action.
A classic sedan from the Vintage Vice City Pack, with a garage at Shore Court by Ocean Beach.
A Mud Club monster for the backwoods of Mount Kalaga, stored at the Paradise Garage in Watson Bay.
Jason's well-worn low-riding pickup. The Ultimate Edition adds a Retro Build mod kit.
An Army fatigue-styled dirt bike at Jason's safehouse.
A kayak kept at Jason's safehouse.
A pink and blue fishing boat docked at Washington Beach, ready for Gambit Bay, with an explosives-laden weapons crate.

sources.label: Rockstar Games: Ultimate Edition and Vintage Vice City Pack

weapons.lede: Every weapon Rockstar has named so far. The full list, with where to get each gun and what it is good for, starts on November 19.

items.d: His and hers revolvers styled after the Vercetti Estate, with palm-tree grips, engraving and a high-performance scope.
Jason's sidearm. The Ultimate Edition adds an engraved personal variant.
Lucia's sidearm, also with an engraved Ultimate Edition variant.
A tropical finish for most guns, based on Tommy Vercetti's palm-tree shirt.
